title: souporcell
description: souporcell is a method for clustering mixed-genotype scRNAseq experiments by individual.

Dataset input.title: Dataset input
Dataset input.description: Dataset input using nf-tower "dataset" or "data explorer". Allows for the input of multiple         parameter sets to initialise a Nextflow channel.

param_list.description: Dataset input can either be a list of maps, a csv file, a json file, a yaml file, or simply a yaml                 blob. The names of the input fields (e.g. csv columns, json keys) need to be an exact match with the workflow input parameters.

clusters.description: number cluster, tbd add easy way to run on a range of k

clustering_method.description:
Clustering method: expectation maximization (em) or k harmonic means (khm).
When not specified, souporcell uses its default (em)

souporcell3.description:
Use souporcell3, which iterates multiple times to refine the results.
Suitable for datasets with a high number of donors (>16).

max_loci.description: max loci per cell, affects speed

restarts.description:
Number of restarts in clustering, when there are > 12 clusters we recommend increasing this to avoid local minima.
When not specified, souporcell uses its default (100).

common_variants.description: common variant loci or known variant loci vcf, must be vs same reference fasta

known_genotypes.description: known variants per clone in population vcf mode

known_genotypes_sample_names.description:
Which samples in the population vcf from the known genotypes option represent the donors in your sample.
The number of sample names must be equal to the number of clusters.

skip_remap.description: dont remap with minimap2 (not recommended unless in conjunction with --common_variants)

max_base_mem.description:
Maximum number of target bases loaded into RAM by minimap2 for indexing (minimap2 -I).
Increase this when minimap2 splits the index, which interferes with the retagging step.

no_umi.description: Set if your BAM file has no UMI tag

umi_tag.description: The BAM tag containing the UMI.

output.description: name of directory to place souporcell files

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
